description: This file defines a Search component using Preact, implementing search functionality with result rendering, pagination, and warnings.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: A Preact component for handling search input, displaying results, warnings, and pagination.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Search component with props and state.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Handles closing the search results view.

methods.name: scrollTop
methods.description: Scrolls the results container to the top.

methods.name: handlePaginate
methods.description: Handles pagination by updating the start index.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Handles input change, updating search term and resetting pagination.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Performs search, deduplicates results, and generates warnings and result list.

methods.description: Renders the search input, results, warnings, and pagination controls.
